title: Free Printable Scavenger Hunts for Kids, Teens and Groups
metaDescription: Free printable scavenger hunt lists for backyards, parks, road trips, beaches, rainy days and holidays. Choose a theme, edit the list and print in minutes.
intro: A scavenger hunt only needs a list, a pencil and somewhere to look. Choose from outdoor hunts, indoor hunts and seasonal hunts below, each with a ready written list that you can edit and print.

sections.heading: Choosing a hunt
body: For a group of young children, start close to home. The [backyard hunt](/scavenger-hunt/backyard/) and the [toddler hunt](/scavenger-hunt/toddler/) use things most families already have around them.

For a rainy afternoon, the [indoor hunt](/scavenger-hunt/indoor-for-kids/) and the [rainy day hunt](/scavenger-hunt/rainy-day/) swap puddles for puzzles. If you have teenagers, the photo hunt in the [teen photo scavenger hunt](/scavenger-hunt/teen-photo/) turns the list into snapshots.
For travel and holiday time, there are hunts for road trips, beach days and camping, as well as for Christmas lights and Halloween.

sections.heading: How the generator helps
body: Any item can carry points after a bar, so you can award extra for hard finds. Choose from a plain checklist, two columns, a photo layout or a team score sheet. Add blank name lines for players, or a timer line for races.
Shuffle the order and print several copies, and each team gets the same items in a different sequence. That stops children from following each other from place to place.

Outdoor hunts work best with a few simple rules. Stay in sight of an adult, look without picking, and leave nature where it was. Our guide to [planning a scavenger hunt](/guides/how-to-plan-a-scavenger-hunt/) explains how to set the boundary and choose prizes, and the [scavenger hunt generator](/scavenger-hunt-generator/) builds any list you can think of.

faq.q: How long does a scavenger hunt take?
faq.a: Most hunts take 20 to 40 minutes. Toddlers can finish a short list in ten, and a long car trip hunt can stretch over hours.

faq.q: Can I print the hunt in black and white?
faq.a: Yes. The checklists are plain text, so black and white looks the same as color.
